Question: The measures of the smallest angles of three different right triangles sum to \(90^\circ.\) All three triangles have side lengths that are primitive Pythagorean triples. Two of them are \(3\)-\(4\)-\(5\) and \(5\)-\(12\)-\(13.\) What is the perimeter of the third triangle?
